CROP: a waist-up shot — the bottom edge crosses her waist; hips, legs and feet are out of frame. skin_exposure: bold — inside the crop, the chosen outfit is worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders and collarbones, skin clearly showing; the crop stays exactly where CROP sets it and never moves down to show more; intimate areas covered
